name: LATAM 2016 livery
description: The LATAM group scheme, worn by LATAM Brasil and the group's other airlines. Fuselage: all white. Cheatlines: none. Tail: white fin crossed by swept coral and indigo bands rising toward the trailing edge; the lowest indigo band runs off the fin root and sweeps down and forward across the rear fuselage as a wedge. Engines: white. Winglets: indigo. Titles: 'LATAM' in wide indigo capitals above the forward windows, the LATAM ribbon symbol just ahead of it. Artwork: the ribbon symbol (coral and indigo folds).

sources.title: PS-LBO, LATAM Brasil Airbus A321neo (Hamburg-Finkenwerder, before delivery), CC BY-SA 4.0, MarcelX42
sources.note: Left side and right side, 2025-06-12: the fin bands, the rear-fuselage wedge, titles, symbol (measured from DSC00682).

sources.title: PR-XBP, LATAM Brasil Airbus A320neo at Teresina, CC BY-SA 4.0, Alexandro Dias
sources.note: Left side, 2024-02-26: in service, same scheme (with a 'Conheça o Brasil' tourism decal, not part of the scheme). Re-checked 2026-11-15: the title, symbol and rear wedge measured on it against its doors and window line.

sources.title: LATAM Airlines Group
sources.note: The brand launched in 2016 for the merged LAN and TAM airlines.

lower indigo band, running on down the fuselage

logos.description: The LATAM symbol: a ribbon folding down in a zigzag, three parallel coral strips slanting down aft, joined by indigo folds at the aft edge, ending in a short indigo stem with a small fold and a detached indigo block at the foot. Same artwork on both sides (not mirrored), always just ahead of the 'LATAM' title.

titles.style: Wide, geometric bold capitals with even strokes, slightly tracked, above the forward windows.

notes: Worn by every LATAM group airline (LATAM Brasil TAM, LATAM Chile LAN, LATAM Perú LPE, LATAM Ecuador LNE, LATAM Colombia ARE, LATAM Paraguay LAP, LATAM Cargo). Photos also show a coral and indigo mark on the belly ahead of the wing, seen only edge-on from the side; its shape isn't drawn (no view from below). Widebodies (787, 777) carry the same fin and title, larger; the rear-fuselage wedge was measured on an A321neo. Re-checked 2026-11-15 on the A320neo (the commonest type, PR-XBP), placed by its doors: the title runs 0.209 to 0.340 (on the A321neo it was 0.179, run 0.09) with the symbol ahead of it; the rear wedge's forward edge is a straight diagonal from the crown at 0.81 to 0.738 low on the side, its lower edge rising to the tailplane, both about 1.5 m forward of the A321neo shares.
history: Replaces Skyarium v1's approximation. The LATAM scheme was introduced in 2016 and replaced TAM's red-and-white and LAN's blue schemes across the group; repainting finished around 2018-2019.
